entities.summary: Lisa Oudens Monaco is an American attorney who served as the 39th United States deputy attorney general from 2021 to 2025. She is a member of the Democratic Party. Lisa Monaco was a legal figures from Boston (b. 1968-02-25, Boston). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
